I couldn't find a `justfile` in this checkout, so I can't tell you which `just` recipe runs the fast tests. The repo still has its `Makefile`, which may mean your change is on another branch. I also found no `just` references anywhere in the repo.

The fast tests are a pytest marker filter, and it doesn't depend on the build tool:

```
python -m pytest -m "not postgres and not integration" -q
```

This skips the tests marked `postgres` (they need `docker compose up db`) and `integration` (they call the payments sandbox over the network). Both markers are registered in `pyproject.toml`.

If your `justfile` has a fast-test recipe, it's probably named something like `just test-fast`. Run `just --list` to see the recipe names. If it doesn't have one, a recipe like this would do it:

```just
test-fast:
    python -m pytest -m "not postgres and not integration" -q
```

I also flagged the stored memory that says "run `make test-fast`" as challenged, since you said the Makefile is gone. I haven't replaced it yet. Once you confirm the `just` command, I can record that instead.
